title: Surreal Fantasy Scene
description: A man in a brown coat stands on a keyboard walkway holding glowing purple rings while facing a robed figure with an orange orb on a pier. A large phoenix flies above a stormy sea with a small boat carrying two people, a Gothic building, and floating magical elements under a dramatic sky.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal fantasy scene of a man in a long brown coat standing on a giant computer keyboard walkway extending over turbulent ocean waves, holding two glowing purple magical rings. In the midground a robed wizard figure stands on a pier holding an orange orb of light. A massive colorful phoenix with red and blue feathers flies across the stormy sky above, with a small wooden boat carrying two people rowing nearby. A large Gothic cathedral building emerges from green glowing waves in the background, with floating lotus flowers, pink petals, and magical symbols throughout the composition, dramatic cinematic lighting.
